findings.summary: Formbricks combines link, website, email, and in-product surveys with cloud and self-hosted deployment options.
Privacy controls, self-hosting, and open code are central reasons regulated and technically capable teams choose it.
Users repeatedly praise the clean survey builder, useful targeting, customization, APIs, and integrations.
Responsive support and a fast shipping pace are repeated positive themes in recent verified reviews.
Some advanced setups, integrations, and self-hosted changes require more technical skill than the no-code surface suggests.
Open-core feature gates, branding limits, and enterprise pricing can frustrate users who expect every capability in the community edition.
The product is not yet as deep or mature as the largest experience-management suites for every enterprise workflow.
Self-hosting is praised as easy by some users and described as difficult or limited by others, so infrastructure skill and feature needs materially change the experience.
The very high public ratings come from relatively small and favorable samples, so they should not be treated as proof of broad-market satisfaction.
